title: A day of back-and-forth: the step and time come up when they matter, not in every reply
origin: Issue #42: "There is no need to repeat the goal constantly" (Yanni)

history.text: Kalimera Priya! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 7 tonight. You in?

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

testerLines: btw is it weird that I skip the appendices
omg my boss just asked me to stay late, can we do 8:30 instead?
whatWentWrong: On Oct 28 ZOH restated the step and time in nearly every text.
shouldHaveHappened: Each reply answers what Priya said. ZOH doesn't tack "ten pages at 7" onto every reply: after her yes it's settled. When she asks to move to 8:30, ZOH moves today's time and confirms the new time once. "cool cool" gets a short reply with no restated step. When she asks what time it was, ZOH says 8:30 plainly.
